articles.title_en: Mediazona names at least 350 Russian conscripts killed in Ukraine despite official Kremlin policy against sending them into combat
articles.lead_en: Mediazona has published a list naming 350 Russian conscripts killed in the war in Ukraine. The outlet, BBC News Russian, and volunteers have been tracking Russian losses through publicly available sources since the start of Russia’s full-scale invasion of Ukraine.
